title: Charming, spacious, clean Guest House w/ king bed!
description:
Charming, spacious, clean, and fun personal guest house above beautiful brick garage on our cul de sac property.  Decorated with pieces from our life to please any type of guest! Quiet, safe family neighborhood. Five minutes from  local joints and beautiful lake-side parks.  25 minutes from downtown Nashville depending on traffic. 12-15 minutes from Mount Juliet shopping and restaurants.

The space
Lovely and fun guest house apartment on our property above the garage. Kitchen with fridge, microwave, Kuerig and sink. Pull out couch.  Breezy trees and gardens outside. Quaint, open floor plan.

Guest access
No access to main house or the deck or hot tub.

Other things to note
There is a kitchen sink, microwave, coffee machine and small refrigerator but no freezer, no stove, and no washer/ dryer.
